items.title: Wall Street Forgot These 3 Dividend Stocks — Now They Pay Over 5%
items.summary: A drugmaker, a telecom giant, and a consumer lender all pay more than most investors expect, yet the market keeps looking away. One of them carries a risk that could turn its payout into a trap.

items.title: 5 “Forever Income” Dividend Stocks Yielding 5% and More for Boomers
items.summary: Two of these retirement income payers slashed their dividends in 2020, and one more cut years earlier. Before you trust any of them with your paycheck, see which safety test each stock passes and which risk could still bite.

items.title: Invest $200,000 in These 5 Dividend Stocks to Fund Your Retirement Income
items.summary: Selling shares in a down market can turn a retirement plan into a slow leak. Five dividend payers across five sectors aim to cover the bills instead, but one of them carries $166.2B of debt, and each one hides a risk worth knowing first.

items.title: Can AT&T's New Apple Device Deals Strengthen Its Subscriber Growth?
items.summary: T is rolling out attractive holiday deals on Apple's latest iPhones, iPads and Apple Watches, aiming to attract new subscribers and boost device sales.

items.title: Musk: FAA Said Free Starlinks Were “Not Needed.” Verizon Holds the Contract for the New System
items.summary: Key TakeawaysElon Musk says the FAA turned down free Starlink service before Friday’s nationwide ground stop, which canceled more than 17,000 flights, and he names Verizon as the company behind the agency’s new network. Musk has a point about the FAA’s network, but the dispute is too small to change the case for Verizon or SpaceX stock.
